description: Farm dams of Western Australia (DPIRD-083) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Spatial boundaries of over 175,000 agricultural dams in Western Australia. This product is an improved version of the ‘Farm dams of the South West agricultural region of WA (DPIRD-083)’ dataset. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are agriculture, dam, farm water, irrigation. It offers 11 resource(s) in .docx, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
